verdict.rationale: Auth0 FGA is documented as a relationship-based authorization platform that decouples complex authorization logic from application code (auth0-docs-62). It is also shown enforcing document-level access control in RAG pipelines (auth0-docs-19, auth0-docs-42), and the access-management pages describe advanced authorization mechanics beyond role definitions (auth0-docs-56, auth0-docs-81). missing for 10: in-depth docs on the authorization modeling language and how resource-level checks are expressed, documentation of policy-based (attribute/condition) rules, independent or hands-on corroboration of FGA in use.
